summary: The explicitly agreed current Mez Systems scope passes authority, accessibility, portability, onboarding, release-governance and named-model artifact certification. A deterministic isolated 1.0.0-rc.2 candidate adds the approved Figma mirror and non-production Product UI foundation without changing frozen rc.1 or certifying deferred channels.

coreValidation.method: Ran all seven AGENT-GUIDE core validators from the project .venv.

currentScopeContracts.method: Ran foundation, expression, component, Golden Homepage, Figma, Product UI, rc.1 and rc.2 validators.

deterministicAssembly.method: Built the repository output and two independent temporary rc.2 roots, then compared complete manifest bytes.
deterministicAssembly.resultDetail: All three produced 351 artifacts, content SHA-256 b5fe5cb5985270987799d28dbd2c596868de0504f84ae1312818c3ac2387fdd5 and manifest SHA-256 129e0faab15173633987fe7c0c66bde982978f850c18b9689412968b718aa2e9.

isolatedVerification.method: Ran the verifier from a temporary package-only copy with an empty environment, isolated Python mode and no dependency installation or network step.
isolatedVerification.resultDetail: The rc.1 baseline contract, new manifest, Figma mirror, Product UI and certification boundaries passed.

modelBenchmark.method: Schema-replayed named GPT-5 and Claude Opus 4.8 repository receipts across seven output classes; ran the same bounded authority and anti-example cases in the current GPT-5.6 Codex context.
modelBenchmark.resultDetail: GPT-5.6 Codex passed 2 of 2 controlled cases. Historical GPT-5 and Claude Opus 4.8 receipts pass the model-neutral schemas. The installed Claude CLI was not logged in, so a fresh same-prompt Claude result is unmeasured.

scopeBoundary.method: Verified explicit certified, bounded, consumer-owned and deferred lists against task and approval records.
scopeBoundary.resultDetail: Nine deferred channel families remain named and uncertified; Figma and Product UI retain noncanonical and nonproduction status.

knownGaps: The installed Claude CLI is not authenticated. Claude Opus 4.8 is represented by real repository receipts and schema replay, but the fresh same-prompt transfer case is not measured.
No exact spoken VoiceOver or NVDA session was recorded for the Product UI workbench or rc.2 package.
Real consumer routing, authentication, persistence, provider logic, commerce, analytics, performance, update and rollback remain PORT-04 work.
The Product UI foundation uses repository fixture evidence and is not a real AI OS workflow.
Third-party-mark legal review, testimonial freshness and continuing consent operations remain consumer-owned.
The nine deferred channel families are deliberately outside this certification and remain future work.

humanDecision.question: Approve this exact certification record and @mez-systems/design-system-web@1.0.0-rc.2 manifest for final named-consumer transition?
approvalWouldAuthorise: Close TASK-CERT-01-SYSTEM-CERTIFICATION for the explicitly agreed current scope.
Treat the exact rc.2 manifest as the approved later candidate supplied to PORT-04.
Make PORT-04 eligible to become ready only after CON-MEZ-SYSTEMS-WEB-001 has one exact repository registration.
approvalWouldNotAuthorise: Publishing the package or Figma library.
Deploying a website or assigning production version 1.0.0.
Changing canonical design decisions, Product UI authority or deferred channel status.
Entering any consumer repository before its exact registration and PORT-04 execution.
